description: This file defines a static class 'JObject' providing methods for loading, parsing, cloning, and merging JSON objects using System.Text.Json. It is part of the OrchardCore project, specifically within the JSON Nodes namespace.

classes.name: JObject
classes.description: A static utility class for handling JSON objects, including loading, parsing, cloning, and merging JSON data.

methods.name: LoadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a JSON object from a stream.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a JSON object from a Utf8JsonReader.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonObject.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Attempts to parse a JSON string into a JsonObject, returning success status.

methods.name: FromObject
methods.description: Creates a JsonObject from a .NET object or JsonElement.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of a JsonObject.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges another JsonNode into a JsonObject with optional settings.
